def compute_feature(loan, client, district, account):
    # Merge client and account to get client's account status
    merged = pd.merge(client, account, left_on='client_id', right_on='account_id')
    
    # Merge with loan to get loan status

def compute_feature(loan, client, account, district, trans):
    # Filter running loans with debt
    running_debt = trans[trans['type'] == 'D']
    running_debt = running_debt[running_debt['balance'] < 0]
    running_debt = running_debt.merge(loan, left_on='account_id', right_on='account_id', suffixes=('', '_loan'))
    running_debt = running_debt[running_debt['status'] == 'R']

    # Filter client data for districts
    client = client.merge(account, left_on='client_id', right_on='client_id', suffixes=('', '_account'))
    client = client.merge(district, left_on='district_id', right_on='district_id', suffixes=('', '_district'))
    client = client.drop(columns=['client_id', '_account', '_district'])

    # Compute unemployment rate increment
    district_data = district.set_index('district_id')
    unemployment_95 = district_data['A2']
    unemployment_96 = district_data['A3']
    unemployment_increment = (unemployment_96 - unemployment_95) / unemployment_95 * 100

    # Merge with running debt
    feature = running_debt.merge(unemployment_increment, left_on='district_id', right_index=True)
    feature = feature.drop(columns=['district_id', 'A2', 'A3'])

    return feature

def compute_feature(loan, account, client, district, A2):
    # Merge loan and account to get account balance
    merged = pd.merge(loan, account, left_on='account_id', right_on='account_id', suffixes=('', '_account'))

    # Merge with client to get client information
    merged = pd.merge(merged, client, left_on='account_id', right_on='account_id', suffixes=('', '_client'))

    # Merge with district to get district information
    merged = pd.merge(merged, district, left_on='district_id', right_on='district_id', suffixes=('', '_district'))

    # Merge with A2 to get unemployment rate
    merged = pd.merge(merged, A2, left_on='A2', right_index=True, suffixes=('', '_A2'))

    # Filter for loans which are still running where client are in debt
    merged = merged[(merged['status'] == 'running') & (merged['balance'] < 0)]

    # Compute percentage unemployment rate increment from year 1995 to 1996
    merged['A2_1995'] = merged['A2'].str.extract('(\d+)', expand=False).astype(int)
    merged['A2_1996'] = merged['A2'].str.extract('(\d+)', expand=False).astype(int)
    merged['unemployment_increment'] = merged['A2_1996'] - merged['A2_1995']

    # Output the result
    return merged[['district_id', 'A2', 'unemployment_increment']]
